events.description: Called with a queued or running task's id when its cancel button is pressed; no cancel button without it.
events.name: onCancel

events.description: Called with a failed task's id when its retry button is pressed; no retry button without it.
events.name: onRetry

events.description: Called with a finished task's id (done, failed or canceled) when its remove button is pressed.
events.name: onDismiss

events.description: Called when "Clear finished" is pressed; the button shows while a task has finished.
events.name: onClear

events.description: Called with the new folded state when the header's toggle is pressed.
events.name: onCollapsedChange

props.description: The tasks, newest first. The tray draws nothing while this is empty.
props.name: tasks

props.description: The tray's name; defaults to the catalogue's "Background tasks".
props.name: label

props.description: True to fold the list to the header, for a controlled tray; pair it with `onCollapsedChange`.
props.name: isCollapsed

props.description: Folded at the start, for an uncontrolled tray. Defaults to false.
props.name: defaultCollapsed

props.description: `docked` (the default) pins it to the bottom end corner of the screen; `inline` leaves it in the flow.
props.name: placement
